title: Sphaira
author: NaGaa95, ITotalJustice
details:
Sphaira is a modern homebrew menu and file-management environment.

It includes a homebrew launcher, file browser, game and application management, install support, MTP and FTP functionality, App Store integration, forwarder creation, theme support, and a wide range of utility features.

This package installs Sphaira to `sd:/switch/sphaira/sphaira.nro`.
changelog:
1.1.1

# Sphaira 1.1.1

### Switch 2 :
- Added MTP support.
- Added Appstore with [Brewstore](https://github.com/HerXayah/brewstore)'s catalog.
- Added the album back to FTP and MTP.

### Switch :
- The homebrew menu now refreshes when an .nro is copied, deleted or renamed over MTP (also on Switch 2).
- Fixed missing display version in NSP names for updates exported from the game card. ([#445](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/445), @strongt1me)
- Compacted the file viewer's text list. ([#449](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/449), @dragonflylee)
